sources.title: QUASAR Compresses Qwen3.8-27B to NVFP4 for Cheaper AI — The Value ...
sources.snippet: QUASAR compresses the 27B Qwen3.8 vision model to 4-bit NVFP4, letting enterprises run multimodal inference on standard GPUs without accuracy loss.

sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: HivenetQuant/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NVFP4 (nvfp4) W4A4 quantization of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B — FP4 (E2M1) weights and activations with FP8 block scales. The MLP is the 4-bit tier; the attention and recurrent (DeltaNet) layers the search protects are kept at FP8.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: The official Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint serves directly on a 950PR — no offline re-quantization and no --quantization ascend. vLLM Ascend reads quant_method: fp8 and weight_block_size straight from the checkpoint, expands the weight_scale_inv tiles at load time and re-quantizes to MXFP8 on 950.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B QUASAR NVFP4 — NInfer artifact This repository documents and packages everything needed to reproduce qwen3_8_27b_nvfp4_quasar.ninfer: the QUASAR QAT NVFP4 (W4A4) variant of Qwen3.8-27B converted to the closed .ninfer artifact format used by the NInfer inference engine, and evaluated on GPQA-Diamond.
